Record Class RabbitMqConnectionInfo

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.controlpanel.panels.rabbitmq.RabbitMqConnectionInfo
Record Components:
name - the connection name: default, or the name under rabbitmq.servers
addresses - the broker addresses, as host:port
virtualHost - the virtual host
username - the user name
ssl - whether TLS is enabled
consumerExecutor - the executor that runs the consumers
channelPoolMaxIdle - the maximum number of idle channels in the pool, if set
state - whether the connection is open
broker - the broker product and version, once connected
public record RabbitMqConnectionInfo(String name, List<String> addresses, String virtualHost, String username, boolean ssl, @Nullable String consumerExecutor, @Nullable Integer channelPoolMaxIdle, RabbitMqConnectionInfo.State state, @Nullable String broker) extends Record
A RabbitMQ connection. Internal to the RabbitMQ panel views.
Since:
2.3.0
Author:
Álvaro Sánchez-Mariscal
